title: An Explicit Polynomial Counterexample to Connes' Embedding Conjecture
summary: We construct an explicit Hermitian polynomial in six selfadjoint variables, $f=-1+ω+ω^*+M\sum_{j=1}^{15}(2-u_j-u_j^*)$, with integer coefficients, degree $72$, and exactly $33$ monomials. Here $ω,u_1,\ldots,u_{15}$ are specified words, $*$ reverses words, and $M$ is a specified positive integer. Its normalized trace is at least $3/4$ on selfadjoint matrix contraction tuples of every dimension, but equals $-1$ at a specified tuple of selfadjoint unitaries in a group von Neumann algebra. Thus $f$ is a counterexample to the algebraic formulation of Connes' embedding conjecture. We also…
